posts.text: Early morning trail run through the McDowell Sonoran Preserve before heading into the office. Nothing beats catching the sunrise over the desert landscape to clear the mind for a busy week ahead!
Enjoying a quiet evening at home with my spouse and our golden retriever after a remarkably productive week of executive strategy sessions. Wishing everyone a wonderful and restful holiday season!
Stepped out for a quick mid-afternoon coffee break in downtown Phoenix. The local roaster downtown makes the absolute best iced oat milk latte to power through the final afternoon meetings.
Reflecting on an incredible year of professional growth and personal milestones as we count down the final days of December. Grateful for an amazing team and looking forward to 2026!
Spent a fantastic Saturday morning volunteering with the local community garden initiative here in Phoenix. It is so rewarding to give back and help promote sustainable neighborhood green spaces.

Celebrating our wedding anniversary with a quiet dinner at our favorite neighborhood bistro. Eight wonderful years together and counting—so thankful for my loving partner through all of life's adventures.
Weekend hiking adventure up Camelback Mountain with family. The summit views never get old, even if the steep climb always gives our legs a proper workout in the summer heat!
Sunday morning meal prep in the kitchen while listening to a favorite jazz playlist. Getting all the healthy lunches organized makes the hectic weekday morning rush so much more manageable.
